name: StarTronix International, Inc.
summary: StarTronix International, Inc. specializes in designing and developing a comprehensive hardware and software platform that integrates computing and communications, specifically targeting both home PC users and the small office/home office (SOHO) market. Central to its offerings is the StarScreen System, an innovative internet-based platform. This system empowers the company's direct marketing online resellers and their customers by providing effortless, one-touch access to the Internet. The StarScreen System seamlessly blends a desktop computer with various telephony options—including landline, wireless, and intelligent handsets—to create a unified computing and communications solution for residential and small business environments. It boasts a meticulously organized online menu that facilitates a range of services such as online banking, electronic bill payments, email, e-commerce, video conferencing, and other supplementary value-added functions. StarTronix was originally established and incorporated in Delaware in August 1995 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Gold Express Communications, Inc. However, just one month later, in September 1995, StarTronix acquired and absorbed its parent company. Interestingly, prior to its current focus, the company was involved in the mining and natural resources industry. StarTronix's corporate headquarters are located in Irvine, California.
